titulo.alumno:
«Который в разных падежах»
Который in different cases

intro: Который agrees with its antecedent in gender and number, but its case depends on its role within the subordinate clause.

frases.estudio: Это тема, о которой мы говорили на семинаре.
frases.alumno: It is the topic we talked about at the seminar.

frases.estudio: Я нашёл статью, которую ты советовал.
frases.alumno: I found the article you recommended.

texto: Который agrees with its antecedent in gender and number, but its case depends on its role within the subordinate clause.
Compare книга, которую я прочитал (object) and книга, которая лежит здесь (subject).

pregunta.texto: Which form completes «о проекте, ___ мы говорили»?

opciones.explicacion: After о the prepositional case is used; проект is masculine: котором.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.
